content: The funct ion Wdg_SetMode shall switch the watchdog driver from the current watchdog mode into the mode given by the argument Mode . This means: By choosing one of a limited number of statically configured settings (e.g. toggle or window watchdog, different timeout p eriods) the Wdg module and the watchdog hardware are switched to one of the following three different modes:  WDGIF_OFF_MODE  WDGIF_SLOW_MODE  WDGIF_FAST_MODE
